verdict.rationale: Code is portable: repositories work with any Git client over HTTPS/SSH, and branches can be mirrored to another Git server. Issues, pull requests and comments can be kept in two-way sync with GitHub, or pulled out through the REST API and the CLI's `--json` output. Pages are also readable as Markdown. However, there is no documented one-step account or organization export of all data (issues, reviews, comments, settings) in an open archive format, so leaving with non-code data takes scripting or depends on GitHub sync. Missing for 10: a documented full-account/org data export feature, an open archive format for issues/PRs/reviews, and hands-on corroboration of a complete exit.
